projection.name: couchdb
projection.title: CouchDB
projection.description: Apache CouchDB cockpit: databases, document CRUD with revision and conflict tooling, Mango queries, map/reduce views, replication and the live changes feed.

fields.label: Host
fields.help: CouchDB node address. Supplied by the agent when the connection is tunnelled.

fields.label: Authentication
fields.help: Cookie session exchanges the password once at /_session and reuses the AuthSession cookie.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Inline password. Prefer a reusable credential when one exists.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks every document, database, index, design-document and replication mutation.

fields.label: Page limit
fields.help: Upper bound on rows fetched per document, view and Mango page.

config.emptyText: No databases yet. Create one to start storing documents.
No compaction, indexing or replication tasks are running.
The replication scheduler has no jobs.
No cluster members were reported by /_membership.
This database has no documents yet.

config.label: Mango selector
config.emptyText: Run a Mango query. The body is POSTed to /{db}/_find and the chosen index is reported with every result. The default selector matches every document through the built-in _all_docs index.
No saved Mango queries for this connection yet.
Only the built-in _all_docs index exists. Create a Mango index to avoid full scans.
No design documents. Add one to define map/reduce views.
No conflicting documents. Replication has converged.
CouchDB reported no revision history for this document.
This document has no conflicting revisions.
This design document declares no views.
This view has no reduce function, so there is nothing to group.
The scheduler has no recorded history for this replication.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Lowercase letters, digits and _$()+-/ only; must start with a letter.

validators.message: must start with a lowercase letter and use a-z 0-9 _ $ ( ) + - /

fields.label: Partitioned
fields.help: Partitioned databases require every document id to be "partition:key".

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this database and every document, index and design document in it?

actions.label: Compact
actions.confirmText: Start compaction? CouchDB rewrites the database file in the background.

actions.label: Clean up views
actions.confirmText: Delete index files for design documents that no longer exist?

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected document(s)? CouchDB writes a deletion tombstone.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this document? CouchDB writes a deletion tombstone.

actions.label: Purge
actions.confirmText: Purge removes the document and all of its revisions from this node. Replicas that already saw it may resurrect it. Continue?

actions.label: Resolve conflicts
actions.confirmText: Keep one revision and delete every other conflicting revision of this document?

actions.label: Resolve conflicts
actions.confirmText: Keep one revision and delete every other conflicting revision of this document?

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this attachment? The document keeps every other field and gains a new revision.

fields.label: Design document
fields.help: Leave empty to let CouchDB pick one.

fields.label: Fields
fields.help: Ordered index keys, e.g. type then created_at.

fields.label: Partial filter selector
fields.help: Optional selector limiting which documents enter the index.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this Mango index? Queries relying on it will fall back to a full scan.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this design document and drop its view indexes?

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this design document and drop its view indexes?

fields.label: Replication id
fields.help: Document id inside _replicator. Generated when empty.

fields.label: Source
fields.help: A local database name is expanded to this connection's own URL; CouchDB 3 rejects bare names inside _replicator.

fields.label: Continuous
fields.help: Keep replicating until the document is deleted.

fields.label: Use this connection's credentials
fields.help: Attaches this connection's username and password to local endpoints. CouchDB stores them in clear text inside the _replicator document.

fields.label: Selector
fields.help: Optional Mango selector restricting which documents replicate.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this replication document? A running job stops immediately.
